g.title: call getint: the next number of the input, 6, arrives in a0; ra holds the way back.
mv: s1 takes a copy of a0, 6.
call getint: the next number of the input, 4, arrives in a0; ra holds the way back.
mv: s2 takes a copy of a0, 4.
beq: s1 is 6, s2 is 4, not equal: no jump, on to the next line.
ble: s1 (6) is more than s2 (4): no jump, on to the next line.
sub: s1 = 6 - 4 = 2: the larger number loses the smaller.
j: back to loop, whatever the registers hold.
beq: s1 is 2, s2 is 4, not equal: no jump, on to the next line.
ble: s1 (2) is not more than s2 (4): jump to smaller.
sub: s2 = 4 - 2 = 2: the larger number loses the smaller.
j: back to loop, whatever the registers hold.
beq: s1 and s2 are both 2: jump to done.
mv: a0 takes a copy of s1, 2.
call putint: a0 (2) is printed. That is the answer.
li: a0 = 0, the status to end with.
call exit: the run ends with status a0, 0, after 17 instructions.
